header.notes: SnowPro-style 'SNOW COVER PROFILE' (older layout). Parks Canada / Banff, Yoho, Kootenay. Obs: BJ BW ML GI MH PW. Profile Type: Test. Date printed '28/12/2005', Time 13:00. H.A.S.L. 2350 Metres; Co-ord blank. HS 54, HSW 0, rho 0. Surface Roughness: Smooth. Foot penetration printed 54 (= HS). Free text below chart: 'ADFAR PROJECT WINTER 2005-2006. UTM: NH 536600 5731300, Map: Hector Lake 82N/9 NAD27. Site description: Open glade 80x80m with an almost complete ring of spruce crumbholds. Danger Rating Pre assessment TL considerable, BTL Low. Danger Rating Post assessment TL considerable BTL Low. CTE 5 RP at 43cm repeatable. CTE 7 SC at 27cm repeatable second result was CTE 10. CTM 20 SC at 18cm variable. RB 2 @ 27 whole block (90-100%)'. Top dashed table row (no glyph) lies above the surface.

transcriber_notes: Low-resolution (627x790) SnowPro-style form (older layout, no branding) -> source_format 'other'. Printed date 28/12/2005 agrees with the file name. Location printed 'Observation Glades TL' (file in the Bow Summit folder, named '05 12 28 observation glades tl'); transcribed as printed. Height axis 2.38 px/cm (0 cm y582); boundaries from H-column leader ends/bar edges: 54/49/43/42/36/35/27/22/18/14/13/0 (+-1 cm). The table has two dashed rows; as in other SnowPro charts the second dashed row maps to the first layer, giving 11 table rows for 11 bars; only rows 35-27 to 14-13 cm carry grain glyphs. Hardness: bar widths on the non-linear axis agree with the R-column icons (blank=F, '+', '/', '/-', '/+', '//', 'X'), which were used to fix the +/- classes (bars ~10/13/22/20/29/22/10/94/20/46/29 px). Temperatures: circles on 23.7 px/deg C (0 C at x265; dashed air line from -7.5 at the plot top vs printed -7.6); the 20 cm circle is partly hidden in the P bar (+-0.2 C).
